annotations.title: Prioritise up to 20 CVEs for patching

description: Prioritise up to 20 CVEs for patching — Turn a list of up to 20 CVE ids into a patch plan: each CVE gets CVSS score and severity, EPSS exploit probability and CISA known-exploited (KEV) status, then the list is ranked KEV first, then EPSS, then CVSS, and tiered PATCH NOW / PATCH THIS WEEK / PATCH THIS MONTH / ROUTINE with an overall verdict. For vulnerability-management and security agents. Pass ?ids= (comma-separated). Price: $0.03 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: security_cve_batch
